data.body:
REB-640 / 08ab — PREFIX A MERGED; FEATURE REBASED + RE-PUSHED (autonomous overnight, ~09:10).

Overnight resolution of the split:
- Prefix A (change 2611) MERGED to main as c57057f4 "Enable the grounding-terraform extra (REB-640 prerequisite)". main's _build-and-test.yml now runs `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra reviewbot --extra ui --extra grounding-terraform` → hcl2 installed on the Verified lane.
- The scanner-integration Verified failure that blocked A earlier was a MAIN-GREEN bug (Makefile scanner-integration target used `@set -euo pipefail` with no SHELL override → dash rejects pipefail on ubuntu). NOT my change. The other session fixed it on main (bare `set -euo pipefail` no longer present in origin/main:Makefile), and A then went Verified+1 and was submitted.

Feature B (change 2603, Change-Id Ic51693e5):
- Rebased onto new origin/main (c57057f4 + ~10 newer commits: reconcile-compat removal, deprecations removal, ADR 0113 fixture-mining, e2e-deps, etc.). Local prefix-A copy dropped (already merged). One conflict resolved: docs/adr/README.md ADR index — kept both 0111 (mine) and 0113 (main) in numeric order.
- Now a SINGLE commit c4edb0c3 (pre-rebase; new SHA after push) on top of main.
- Validation on the advanced base: make lint PASS; make typecheck 763 files clean; grounding held-out oracle + coupled parity cluster (tests/unit/grounding, terraform pass1 wiring, terraform plan-review tools, test_core_optionality, test_ci_workflow_parity, test_capabilities, test_collection_isolation_guard, test_mechanism_delta) = 424 passed, 0 false-refutes, refute-yield 72.5%.
- Pushed new patchset to 2603 (git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main). Stale LLM-Review+1 / Verified-1 removed (new patchset). Fresh CI running now.

Advisory carried from A's review (residual-gap candidate): supply-chain — lark pinned only in uv.lock, not pyproject (python-hcl2 transitive). Non-blocking.

NEXT: poll 2603 for Verified+1 + LLM-Review+1 (grounding tests should now pass with hcl2 on the lane). Then close 08ab (completion-verify gate; needs referencing commit reachable from HEAD — satisfied, HEAD carries rebar-ticket:08ab). Then siblings afe3→1c52→c6ce (linear depends_on chain; blocked until 08ab closes), epic close, land stack. PS2 terraform_parse.py:90 _declarations positional-correlation concern still to disposition in residual sweep.
